newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Interneuron.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Interneuron.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it initiated coverage of Interneuron Pharmaceuticals Inc as a buy and a $48 share price target.
-- Lehman said it sees Interneuron as a "core holding" in a biotechnology investment portfolio.
-- Lehman said Interneuron "is armed with perhaps the richest arsenal in biotechnology" with several late-stage products and a pipeline of other products.

-- Lehman said Interneuron's stock will be driven by increasing sales of the obsesity drug Redux, in-licensing of new drug candidates, and the announcement of a European partner for bucindolol by year-end.
